cohort: 100 postnatal mothers who underwent lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) were purposively sampled, with 50 in an experimental group and 50 in a control group.
finding: Almond oil massage significantly increased breast milk adequacy in the experimental group (90%) compared to the control group (80%).
